notes: All 11 source and 11 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.

The oath frame *As ... liveth* is kept whole on חַי (discontinuous around the divine name under rule 25). The unit's note calls *As* a copula, which is loose — it is the English oath formula's subordinator — but the placement is defensible on rule 45's reasoning that a construction's frame belongs to the morpheme producing it. The competing reading, not named in the unit note, is rule 55: no conjunction stands in the Hebrew clause, so *As* would be its own `added` unit. I leave the accepted reading standing.
לָכֵן → *surely* fuses under rule 30 and heads on s001, whose lemma carries the whole expression; this matches the לָכֵן and עַל־כֵּן units elsewhere in the chapter (JER.5.6, 5.14, 5.27).
